COUNT I DEFAMATION

85. Plaintiff Roberts re-alleges paragraphs | — 84 as if the same were fully set forth herein. Dershowitz made his false and defamatory statements deliberately and maliciously with the intent to intimidate, discredit and defame Roberts.

86. In December 2018, and thereafter, Dershowitz, on behalf of himself and Epstein, intentionally and maliciously released to the press his false statements about Roberts in an attempt to destroy Roberts' reputation and brand her as a liar and cause her to lose all credibility in her efforts to help victims of sex trafficking.

87. Dershowitz and Epstein knew that Dershowitz's assertions would dilute, discredit, and neutralize Roberts's public and private messages to sexual abuse victims and ultimately prevent Roberts from effectively providing assistance and advocacy on behalf of other victims of sex trafficking, or expose her abusers.

88. Using his role as a powerful lawyer with powerful friends, Dershowitz's statements were published internationally for the malicious purpose of further damaging a sexual
